settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: How the panel behaves and what the overlay shows.

hotkeys.title: Shortcuts
hotkeys.hint: Click a shortcut and press the combination. It is registered in the desktop as soon as you let go.

hud.title: Overlay
hud.hint: What is drawn over the game: the state of the mode, the numbers of the machine and the controls, without opening the window.

modes.simpleText: A small card in a corner, to look at out of the corner of your eye.
modes.advancedText: A panel of the height of the screen, with every detail.

scx.title: Scheduler
scx.hint: The sched_ext scheduler that runs while you play. The scx_loader service starts and stops it.
scx.noKernel: This kernel does not have sched_ext, so there is no scheduler to choose here.
scx.noService: The kernel has sched_ext, but the scx_loader service is not installed.

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.subtitle: Live use of the machine while a game runs.

gamemode.title: GameMode
gamemode.subtitle: Governor of the kernel and the graphics card while you play.
gamemode.serviceOff: The game mode service is stopped.
gamemode.serviceOffHint: Without it the system settings cannot be changed.
gamemode.viewHint: Choose how much you want to see. The basic view is enough to play.
gamemode.onText: Ready. Everything goes back to normal when you close the game.
gamemode.pendingText: Some pieces are missing for the game mode to give its best.

kernel.title: Kernels on this machine
kernel.hint: The ones installed and which one is in use. Installing or changing the one that boots is Kernel Installer's job.
kernel.plainHint: The game mode works with this kernel, but the new scheduler needs another one that brings it.

gamemode.effect: While you play it raises the processor frequency, takes the graphics to the top and clears the disk. When the game closes, everything goes back to how it was.
gamemode.unitMissing: This installation does not include the game mode service: it comes in the .deb package.
gamemode.gameModeText: GameMode daemon of the system: gives the game priority and keeps the screen saver away. It can be used together with the profiles.
gamemode.automaticText: Applies the profile by itself and undoes it when the game closes.
gamemode.excludedHint: Press to take it into account again
gamemode.applyError: The profile could not be applied
gamemode.strongText: Everything at its limit while you play.
gamemode.coolText: Less heat and less fan, giving up some performance.
gamemode.iniSystem: There is also a /etc/gamemode.ini of the system. The panel leaves it alone: it writes yours, which is read after it.

profile.maxText: Everything at the limit: high frequency, graphics at full and the disk cleared for the game.
profile.balancedText: Good in the game without burning power or heat.
profile.quietText: For laptops: less heat and less fan, giving up some performance.

reason.no_cpufreq: This processor has no frequency control
reason.no_epp: The driver offers no energy preference
reason.no_pstate: amd_pstate is not driving this processor
reason.no_thp: This kernel has no huge pages
reason.no_sysctl: This kernel has no such setting
reason.no_split_lock: This processor does not need that mitigation
reason.no_disk: No disk lets the scheduler be chosen
reason.no_gpu_level: This driver does not let the level be set

lever.vm_page_cluster: Pages read from swap at once
lever.vm_dirty_writeback_centisecs: Interval of the writes to disk

mangohud.title: MangoHud
mangohud.subtitle: What the game overlay of MangoHud shows.
mangohud.preset_performanceText: Unlimited FPS and every reading of the machine on screen.
mangohud.preset_readableText: Large text and a soft background to read at a glance.
mangohud.preset_minimalText: Only FPS and processor and graphics use.
mangohud.noEntries: The file has no settings yet.
mangohud.missing: The file does not exist yet; it is created as soon as you tick something.
mangohud.fpsLog: Let the panel read the FPS
mangohud.fpsLogHint: The overlay takes the FPS from a log of MangoHud. MangoHud only writes one when its file says where.
mangohud.fpsLogOn: The panel reads the FPS from {path}
mangohud.error: The file could not be written

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: The games already installed on this machine.
library.emptyHint: The games of the desktop menu and the ones of Steam are read without opening a launcher.
library.error: The list of games could not be read

tweak.title: System optimizations
tweak.hint: The same ones Soplos Welcome offers, applied from here.
tweak.overlayHint: MangoHud, goverlay, gamescope, vkBasalt and dxvk from Flathub.
tweak.ryzenadjHint: RyzenAdj for small AMD machines. It is installed from Welcome.
